output.reason: The migration guide [ev-d1948f134793] says the TCP LoadBalancer `terminationDelay` option was removed from dynamic configuration, but it does not name the IngressRouteTCP CRD field. The deterministic CRD check found that IngressRouteTCP spec.routes[].services[].terminationDelay is still in the v3.0.0 schema [ev-f7d1f0ce407c, ev-caea0ddc58f9]. So it is unproven that environments setting this CRD field are exposed. The proposed condition may also miss environments that set loadBalancer.terminationDelay in file or other providers, which no CRD predicate captures. To decide, I need the v3.0.0 code or reference docs showing whether the CRD field is still honoured or now ignored, and which providers' configuration surfaces lost the option.
